experiment.name: Weight-Tied Transformer Refinement Sufficiency Pilot
experiment.research_object: Six recurrent applications of one Transformer block on shortcut-free retrieval

hypotheses.primary: In a learned recurrent Transformer computation, ordered state history predicts future decision changes beyond current, dimension-matched, shuffled, and sample-mismatched controls.
hypotheses.attention: Ordered attention-summary history predicts future decision changes beyond current state plus current attention and matched attention-history controls.
hypotheses.secondary: Ordered state and attention histories improve prediction of future reduction in negative log-likelihood.
hypotheses.null: Earlier refinement states and attention summaries add no stable predictive information after current state and current attention are available.

interpretation_boundary: Probe improvements establish incremental decodability under the stated controls; they do not by themselves establish causal use or metacognition.
